title: Peace Bell (Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park)

place.label: Peace Memorial Park, Hiroshima
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

tiers.everyday: The Peace Bell in Hiroshima was finished in 1964. Visitors strike it to pray for a world without nuclear weapons.
tiers.student: The foundation gives completion on 20 September 1964, about 1 m across, 1.7 m high and about 1,200 kg.

model.label: Parametric profile scaled from the sourced diameter and height; the curve itself is a generic Western bell profile, not a scan.
